rules.name: Darkness is coming...
rules.description: The player is allowed to activate one unit more or less than shown in the Activation Roll. At least 1 unit must always be activated

rules.name: Your Souls Belong to Us!
rules.description:
If the Lord Necromancer’s opponent rolls a 1 or 2 in an Initiative Test, he loses the test regardless of other rules, magic items, modifiers, or re-roll opportunities

Also, if the enemy has lost 5 or more Blood Points, you may roll a d6 once per cycle when activating the Lord Necromancer. A score of 2 or less means you can place a unit of The Damned* (4 bases) facing any direction without an Action Die within 20 cm of the Lord Necromancer. In a new cycle, the unit receives an Action Die and can be activated normally. It does not count towards lost Blood Points when destroyed

In the army of the Lord Necromancer, Truhlaks on Fallen Ogars are the Elite Units, not the Rare Units

rules.name: Ab... huul! Daaqul, salib!!!
rules.description: The Ritual Master (Mage) is always included in the army for free. He is counted to the Mages limit and may use any magic spells and items.

rules.name: Ab... huul! Daaqul, salib!!!
rules.description:
Before the battle, the Mage performs a special ritual. Roll a d6 to see what bonus the units will get:
1–2 Ritual of the Beast Each Basic and Elite Unit in the army has movement and charge increased by 2 cm
3–4 Ritual of the Pain Each Basic and Elite Unit in the army, if it has no protection or armour, may always roll a d6 for each Wound it is dealt. On a score of 1, the Wound is cancelled
5–6 Ritual of the Darkness Each Basic and Elite Unit in the army has the Fear rule. After a successful charge with this unit, the enemy must take a Panic Test for 1 base. If the unit is a horde, the enemy must take a Panic Test for 2 bases

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: After a failed charge, this unit cannot be rotated by the opponent

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: After a failed charge, this unit cannot be rotated by the opponent

rules.name: Corpse Horde
rules.description:
After each lost combat, this unit must roll a d6. The score is the number of additional Wounds it receives. Truhlaks in the Lord Necromancer’s army can add a rank of Marauders to the horde that allowed them to be deployed (such a horde is 20 bases). 
Only Lord Necromancer can be attached to the Truhlaks unit

rules.name: Corpse Horde
rules.description:

Only Lord Necromancer can be attached to the Truhlaks unit

rules.name: Fanatical Loyalty
rules.description: In the army of the Lord of Sheol-morg, as long as this unit is a Horde, it may sacrifice one base to re-roll the failed order issued to them by the General

rules.name: Amok
rules.description: After Minotaur’s attacks, roll a d6 for each Wound dealt to the enemy. Each score of 1 and 2 means the enemy is dealt an additional Wound

rules.name: Spasms
rules.description: Before combat, this unit receives a d6+1 attack bonus. If this unit is a horde, the number of bonus attacks is d6+4

rules.name: Dark Vomit
rules.description: After a successful charge with Hydra, and after positioning the units, choose target enemy unit within 10 cm. Roll 5d6 – each score of 2 or less means the target enemy unit is dealt 1 Wound

rules.name: Born in the Abyss
rules.description: While fighting Hydra, the enemy cannot use charge bonuses

rules.name: Curser
rules.description: Every enemy unit in 30 cm from the Curser has -2 to the charge range

rules.name: Warlock
rules.description: Every friendly unit in 20 cm from the Warlock can re-roll the prayer for Fury

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Gehenna is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, make a d6 test before the fight. A score of 3 or less means the chosen unit’s stat (except W) can be increased by 1 until the end of the cycle

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Make a d6 test if the unit with the Champion of Hordes attached made a successful charge or has been charged. A score of 3 or less means the unit which has at least 12 bases may re-roll all failed scores in the Weapon Skill Test, and if the unit wasn’t a horde or it lost its rule, it gains (regains) the horde’s rules.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Dark Gods is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, it always adds 5 attacks instead of 4. In addition, you can make a d6 test before the enemy’s attacks. A score of 3 or less means that the enemy must, according to your choice, re-roll all successful scores in the Weapon Skill Test or the Wound Test.

rules.name: Azargal – The Axe of the Dead
rules.description: Gnat supports the unit with 6 attacks. Additionally, if an enemy is dealt damage during combat with a unit Gnat is attached to and has a Wound marked after it, it is dealt 2 additional Wounds.

rules.name: Gnat
rules.description: Gnat can be fielded in the Lord Necromancer's army regardless of the number of other heroes. Gnat can support any unit, including Truhlaks

rules.name: Grave Shield
rules.description: If the unit Gnat is attached to has no protection, it gains protection on 1s and 2s.

rules.name: Horned Helm
rules.description:
If the unit Gnat is attached to has the Fear rule, the enemy must always take Panic Tests for 3 bases instead of 1 or 2. Additionally, once per cycle, a selected friendly Truhlaks unit within 30 cm of Gnat gets the opportunity to roll a d6 after removing its Action Die.

1	The unit can increase its Mobility (M) by 5 and roll again for the table. Effects are cumulative.
2-4	The unit can increase its Strength (S) by 2
5	The unit can turn freely
6	No effect

Bonuses gained last until the end of the cycle.

rules.name: Servant
rules.description: If Gnat is killed, remove his model and place a Death Counter in his place. At the start of each cycle, roll a d6. On a score of 3 or less, you may place the Gnat model, along with an Action Die, within 10 cm of the Death Counter, then remove the counter.

rules.name: Sower of Graves
rules.description: After charging, Rotgant can roll a d6. The result is the number of additional attacks he receives. On a score of 6, Rotgant does not attack, but instead he stumbles and falls directly into the enemy. Roll 2d6. The obtained score is the number of Wounds dealt to the enemy and Rotgant himself. The enemy cannot use any protection or armour if Rotgant falls

rules.name: Captured Artefacts
rules.description:
Once per battle, Rotgant can use a magic item following the same rules as Mages, but must roll a d6 to see which item he has grabbed. Roll a d6.
1-2 Staff. See the main rulebook
3-5 Diadem of Despair. See the main rulebook
6 Bag of Stuff. Unfortunately, after looking through the contents, Rotgant lost interest in the artefacts he has acquired. If Rotgant has an Action Die, he must remove it.

rules.name: Mage Hunter
rules.description: Rotgant, upon base contact with an enemy Mage, eliminates them from play on a score of 4 or less instead of 2 or less.

rules.name: Skeletons Command Group
rules.description:
The specific magical aura of the Skeletons Command Groups means that in order to effectively support the army, they cannot attach to any units. If an enemy unit comes into contact with such a Command Group and it is not eliminated, it must be moved up to 15 cm to any
place on the battlefield.

If the Skeletons Command Group is within 5 cm of a friendly unit, that unit may use special rules:
• After declaring a charge, the unit can (even despite the difficulties or obstacles) roll 3d6 for the charge instead of the roll that he could normally make, and choose 2 highest scores.
• The unit can make a special sideways or backwards move up to 5 cm + d6 instead of its standard move or charge.
• After each lost combat, the Truhlaks unit does not have to roll for the additional Wounds it could receive.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Choose one enemy unit within 30 cm of the Champion of Catacombs and roll a d6. A score of 3 or less means the chosen unit must re-roll its highest result when rolling for the charge distance. Additionally, if any enemy unit within 15 cm takes a Prayer Test, it must roll 3 dice and choose the highest 2 results.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Choose one unit of Truhlaks or Ghosts within 20 cm of the Champion of Ghosts and roll a d6. A score of 4 or 3 means that the chosen unit gains +1 to A. A score of 2 or less means that the chosen unit gains +1 to A and +1 to WS.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Choose one unit of Truhlaks or Gnils within 20 cm of the Champion of Graves and roll a d6. A score of 4 or less means that the chosen unit may re-roll one d6 when rolling for the charge distance.

rules.name: The Eternal Generals
rules.description: If there is at least one unit of Mementors fielded in the army, the pool of Lord Necromancer's orders in that army is increased by 1.

rules.name: Memento Ultionis
rules.description: Mementors add d6 attacks to the pool when fighting an enemy unit that has a Champion attached to it, or 2d6 attacks if it's a General or a Legendary Hero.

rules.name: Rot
rules.description: The enemy unit (but not single model) with WS better than 2 gains - 1 to WS when fighting Gnils.

rules.name: Bloodthirst
rules.description: The unit has +1 to A when charging an enemy unit or +2 to A when charging an enemy unit that has a Horde rule.

rules.name: Ghosts
rules.description: Marauders rule does not apply.

rules.name: Aura of Destruction
rules.description: The Ghosts' aura gives their weapons extraordinary properties. Ghosts do not perform a Wound Test. Instead, each successful hit in the WS Test automatically deals a Wound, and each result of 1 automatically deals 2 Wounds. No armour/ protection saves against Ghosts' attacks.

rules.name: Ethereal
rules.description: An enemy unit can only perform a Wound Test against Ghosts if it has a Mage attached to it or has successfully performed any prayer before attacking.

rules.name: Myrnos
rules.description: Obsessed with madness, Myrnos always has 5 attacks + 1 attack for each rank of the unit he is attached to.

rules.name: Axe of Malice
rules.description: This axe, endowed with a foul soul, confuses Myrnos's mind and causes him to go mad. If an enemy unit (but not a single model) loses combat to a unit Myrnos is attached to, roll four d6s before the enemy takes a Cold Blood Test. Any score of 4 or less means that Myrnos inflicts additional Wounds on the enemy. Any double of 6 means that the unit Myrnos is attached to loses 1 base.

rules.name: Hunger for Murder
rules.description: The regrouping range of the unit Myrnos is attached to is 3d6 cm instead of 5 cm.

rules.name: Belt of Servant
rules.description: If Myrnos is eliminated from battle, he is not counted as a Blood Point for the enemy.

sharedRules.name: Heavy Armour
sharedRules.description: Each Wound dealt to this unit can be cancelled by a massive armour. Roll a d6. A score of 2 or less means a cancelled Wound

sharedRules.name: Skeletons Champions
sharedRules.description: The specific magical aura of the Skeletons Champions means that in order to effectively support the army, they cannot attach to any units. If an enemy unit comes into contact with such a Champion and it is not eliminated, it must be moved up to 15 cm to any place on the battlefield.
